title_zh: 确认农场参观的宠物和围栏规则

scenario.goal_zh: 确认宠物限制并了解观赏牲畜的位置

context_zh: 学习农业的努尔到教学农场咨询周末参观安排，导览员彼得说明参观范围和动物区规则。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Visitor Noor
sentences.text: I am studying agriculture, and I would like to see your crop trial on Saturday.

sentences.speaker: Guide Peter
sentences.text: Of course. That field covers one acre, and the visitor path goes around its edge.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Noor
sentences.text: Can I bring my dog if I keep her on a lead?

sentences.speaker: Guide Peter
sentences.text: I am afraid pets cannot enter the farm. The animal area is part of the same visitor route.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Noor
sentences.text: I will leave her at home. Where can visitors see the goats?

sentences.speaker: Guide Peter
sentences.text: From the path behind the wooden barrier. Please stay on the visitor side and do not feed them.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Noor
sentences.text: Thanks. I will follow the marked path around the field and then look at the goats from there.

targets.sense_zh: 阻挡或分隔区域的围栏或障碍物
